n, b = map(int, input().split())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
prefix_balances = []
balance_counter = 0

for num in nums:
    if num % 2 == 0:
        balance_counter += 1
    else:
        balance_counter -= 1
    prefix_balances.append(balance_counter)

differences = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    if prefix_balances[i] == 0:
        differences.append(abs(nums[i] - nums[i + 1]))

differences.sort()

total_cuts = 0
current_sum = 0

for diff in differences:
    if current_sum + diff <= b:
        current_sum += diff
        total_cuts += 1
    if current_sum >= b:
        break

print(total_cuts)
</translated_code>
